titles_en.title: How to Completely Let You Go
How to Give Up on You Completely

description:
"Did I ever give you any room, Yeonhee?" Jeong-hoon clicked his tongue as if in pity. 

She had believed that her relationship with Team Leader Min Jeong-hoon, whom she had secretly loved, was love. Knowing that revealing her true feelings would mark the end, she buried them deep inside. Yet even in that desperate love, cracks inevitably appeared. 

"I’m sorry, Team Leader. But this already ended a long time ago." 

Now, she was ready to abandon him completely.
